name: Hot ginger rice dumplings
summary: Bánh trôi tàu nóng is the sweet dumpling in ginger broth. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, says the filling is black sesame and mung bean, and the skin is soft. Báo Quảng Ninh’s English edition, 23 Jul 2021, also names coconut milk. Both stay.
origin: Hạ Long. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, lists it with the salty plates as the sweet.
taste: VnExpress calls the skin soft and the ginger fragrant and sweet.
howToEat: VnExpress: black sesame and mung bean, in a hot ginger broth. The skin is soft and the ginger stays after you swallow.

Báo Quảng Ninh’s English edition, 23 Jul 2021, says the broth is ginger and coconut milk, and printed about 10,000–30,000 đồng a bowl. The Vietnamese VnExpress article does not print that price or the coconut milk. Both stay. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Snack stalls around trường Chuyên Hạ Long and inside chợ Cột 3, phường Hồng Hải, on the VnExpress account. That ward name is from 16 Mar 2021.
seoTitle: Banh troi tau — hot ginger dumplings in Ha Long
seoDescription: Bánh trôi tàu in Hạ Long is a black-sesame and mung-bean dumpling in hot ginger broth. One 2021 account also says coconut milk. A current price is Check on arrival.
